# Week 13: Term Project Presentations, Part 2 {.unnumbered}

## Overview

Week 13 completes [M5: Final Presentation](../../milestones/m5-presentation/README.md) and turns presentation feedback into final portfolio revision. The last step is not more drafting; it is making the project clear, reproducible, and ready for assessment.

## Timing Rules

Each presentation uses this timing:

- 7 minutes for the presentation
- 3 minutes for questions
- 1 minute for transition

<!-- AI-EDIT(2026-06-11): MIT-107, WI-063 — needs review -->
Presentation order will be posted on Canvas here: [insert Canvas link]. Check this page before presentation day and notify the teaching team if your group is missing. Groups presenting in Part 2 should submit slides before class using the same M5 submission folder as Week 12.

## Slide Submission

Commit and sync:

```text
milestones/m5-presentation/submission/slides.qmd
milestones/m5-presentation/submission/slides.html
```

If you render to PDF instead of HTML, submit `slides.pdf`. Submit the GitHub repository link on Canvas with the latest commit hash and the slide path.

## Closing Reflection

After presenting or reviewing, write a short note for your group:

- What claim felt strongest?
- What limitation needs to be clearer in the final portfolio?
- What reproducibility issue still needs one final check?
- What audience-facing improvement would make the KT product easier to use?

Use the note to guide final revisions.

## Final Portfolio Reminder

The final portfolio package is described in [Final Portfolio](../../milestones/final-portfolio/README.md). Before submission, complete the [Final Portfolio Checklist](../../milestones/final-portfolio/final-portfolio-checklist.md) and confirm the repository sharing choice using [Repository Sharing Guidance](../../milestones/final-portfolio/repository-sharing-guidance.md).

## Final Revision Priorities

Focus the remaining time on:

- rendering the final report
- checking dashboard or KT product access
- fixing broken paths
- clarifying data provenance and limitations
- completing the AI-use note
- submitting the repository link and commit hash on Canvas

## Definition Of Done

Week 13 is done when all presentations are complete, peer feedback has been returned, and each group has a clear final portfolio checklist for the last submission.
